revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree that there are no traces of a diaeresis on iota in lins1 and 6 nor in lin2 of the verso. Delete the diaeresis mark up. See Mirizio's remarks. I would indicate the hand change as given in Chrest.Mitt. 8.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with the change of accent, but I see no diaeresis in the papyrus in lines 1 and 6, nor in l. 2 on the verso. I guess it was inserted in the P.Enteux. edition to distinguish the female version of the name from the male one (see comment in P.Lille at l.1). I would only leave the regularized forms as corrections and possibly the change of hand

Submit - L. 9 has θορταϊν, not θορταϊον (both P.Enteux and pap.); therefore, the accent here should be (as in P.Enteux.) Θορτάιν. // P.Enteux. prints Θοτορτάιον, not Θοτορταῖον in l. 2 of the verso. // The verso is, I believe, written by a third hand; Chrest.Mitt. notes this as well, but neither P.Lille nor P.Enteux. have this in the ed. or comment on it.

Commit - L. 9 has Θορτάιν, not Θορταῖον (both P.Enteux. and photo). In l. 2 of the verso, P.Enteux. has Θοτορτάιον, not Θοτορταῖον. The verso is, I believe, written by a third hand; Chrest.Mitt. notes this, but neither P.Lille nor P.Enteux. show this in the edition or comment on it.
Commit - L. 9 has Θορτάιν, not Θορταῖον (both edition and photo). Also, I changed the accent l. 2 according to P.Enteux., where it is Θοτορτάιον, respectively, not (as in the PN) Θοτορταῖον.

Commit - L. 9 has Θορτάιν, not Θορταῖον (both edition and photo). Also, I changed the accent here and in l. 2 of the verso according to P.Enteux., where it is Θορτάιον and Θοτορτάιον, respectively, not (as in the PN) Θορταῖον and Θοτορταῖον.
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine
Submit - The line 10 was displayed in two separated lines. I deleted the unncessary line 13 (before the l. 12), according to the edition.
